topics.purpose: Define deterministic rolling deployment over exact target batches with minimum service-capacity and verification constraints.

semantics.target_rule: Full target set and batch partition are exact.
semantics.capacity_rule: Minimum available/ready capacity during rollout is explicit.
semantics.verify_rule: Each batch verifies before progression where required.
semantics.failure_rule: Batch failure pause/rollback/continue semantics are explicit.
semantics.state_rule: Old/new version populations remain visible during transition.
semantics.authority_rule: Batch progression still requires deployment execution authority.

invariants.rule: Release candidate, accepted release, deployment plan, deployment execution, installed artifact, active runtime instance and observed health remain separate identities/states.
Operational convenience, availability pressure, maintenance state, automation, recovery or rollback never silently bypass validation, authorization, integrity, governance or dispatcher boundaries.
